top_signals.title: Bell Canada says 'agentic' hacker stole enterprise customer data
top_signals.summary: Bell Canada has confirmed that an "agentic" threat actor breached its systems on November 17, 2026, and stole enterprise customer data, including information from a system used to order and provision telecommunications circuits. [...]
